resources.string: This recovery-only update keeps the normal Notes screen closed while you save a copy of the app’s local storage. Your original files will not be moved, reset or overwritten. No account is required and nothing is uploaded automatically.

The copy is encrypted for Stellar Support. Support can decrypt the exported package and inspect its files. Notes already protected by your old app password remain protected; this tool cannot bypass that password. Do not enter or send your Stellar ID password.
I understand the copy may contain private notes, folders, settings and sign-in information, and Stellar Support can inspect the exported copy.
I agree to create an encrypted copy for recovery. I choose where to save it and whether to share it with Stellar Support.
Your original storage stays on this phone. After saving, share the recovery file only through the support channel you trust.
Preparing and checking the encrypted copy…
Recovery copy saved. Your original storage has not been changed. Nothing was uploaded. You can now share the saved file with Stellar Support.
The recovery copy could not be prepared. No original files were changed. Close other Notes windows and try again, or contact support.
Export cancelled. No original files were changed.
Saving did not finish. The selected destination may contain an incomplete file; do not send it. No original files were changed. Try again.
